items.title: Meet St. George Mama
items.goal: Introduce the St. George Mama brand and its range in one reel.
items.desc: The introduction reel — a run through the local businesses, markets and desert mornings that make up the St. George Mama beat.

items.title: Vintage Market Days
items.goal: Drive weekend footfall to a travelling market with a short run.
items.desc: A wander through the stalls — handmade bookmarks, stacked vintage books, bunting overhead. Shot to feel like you are walking it yourself.

items.title: The Mod Market
items.goal: Make a whole wall of small products readable in a single scroll.
items.desc: A full wall of earrings, shot close and moving slowly so every pair reads before the cut.

items.title: The Mathis Market
items.goal: Sell the atmosphere of the market, not just the merchandise.
items.desc: Vendor booths under string lights, colour-led cuts that carry the browsing rhythm of the market.

items.title: The Spring Market
items.goal: Put a pop-up vendor in front of a local audience before the weekend.
items.desc: Permanent jewelry and piercings at the spring pop-up, with the signage given room to land.

items.title: Chained & Charmed
items.goal: Explain permanent jewelry to people who have never seen it done.
items.desc: Permanent jewelry, welded on the spot. Tight focus on hands and chain so the craft is the story.

items.title: Krazy K Maks
items.goal: Turn a browsing moment into a reason to visit the booth.
items.desc: Reaching into the case for the pick of the day — shot handheld and close for that first-person pull.

items.title: Downtown Farmers Market
items.goal: Give a weekly market something fresh to post.
items.desc: Iced and decorated cookies laid out on the tray, framed so the colour does the selling.

items.title: Handmade jewelry booth
items.goal: Show a maker's full range without a studio setup.
items.desc: A maker's table styled end to end — trays of stones, hanging pairs, everything catching the daylight.

items.title: Market hall walkthrough
items.goal: Convey the size of the hall to someone deciding whether to go.
items.desc: Following the aisle through a covered market — a walking shot that lets the scale of the room register.

items.title: Market day, first sip
items.goal: One story frame that reads instantly.
items.desc: Nine seconds, one beat: the drink, the grin, the green tents behind. Built for a story frame.

items.title: Statement piece
items.goal: Make a single statement product carry the whole reel.
items.desc: A mirrored cowboy hat throwing light around the room — shot to make one object the whole reel.

items.title: Styling on chevron oak
items.goal: Style a product flat-lay that still feels handmade.
items.desc: Flat-lay staging on a herringbone table, product moved into frame by hand rather than cut to.

items.title: In-use product demo
items.goal: Answer "what is it actually like to use" in one shot.
items.desc: Hands, water, lather — the everyday-use shot brands ask for, kept unglamorous on purpose.

items.title: Summit View at Cedar Pointe
items.goal: Sell the feeling of a finished home to a buyer who cannot visit.
items.desc: Interiors walked slowly and evenly — canopy bed, fan turning, light held long enough to sell the room.

items.title: Model home walkthrough
items.goal: Walk a buyer through a near-finished build.
items.desc: A walking tour of a near-finished build, paced so each room lands before the next.

items.title: New build at dusk
items.goal: Make a finished exterior look like somewhere to live.
items.desc: Golden hour on a finished exterior, warm windows against a cooling sky.

items.title: Framing stage walkthrough
items.goal: Show progress to buyers waiting on a build.
items.desc: Open studs and bare subfloor — the in-progress footage builders use to show work underway.

items.title: Commercial exterior
items.goal: Give a commercial building a clean hero shot.
items.desc: Clean architectural lines shot against desert sky, framed for a wide crop.

items.title: Tile & fixture detail
items.goal: Sell the finish detail that still photos flatten.
items.desc: Glass, tile and running water — a finish-detail shot for a build or fixture brand.

items.title: Rooftop solar install
items.goal: Let a happy customer do the selling.
items.desc: Panels on a finished roof with a spoken client review over the top — proof-of-work content for a home services install.

items.title: Red rock, from the air
items.goal: Show Southern Utah from an angle even locals have not seen.
items.desc: FPV drone over the sandstone — the aerial work that separates her reel from phone-only creators.

items.title: Aerial over the valley
items.goal: Set the geography for a tourism audience.
items.desc: A drone push down the highway with the mesas stacked behind it.

items.title: Fossil Hills Park
items.goal: Help parents choose where to spend the morning.
items.desc: Shade sails, slides and open sky — a park piece cut for parents deciding where to spend the morning.

items.title: Playground afternoon
items.goal: Make a public park look worth the drive.
items.desc: Colour-blocked play surfaces under sail shades, shot low and bright.

items.title: Water in the desert
items.goal: Explain in ten seconds why people move here.
items.desc: Red rock breaking to open water — the shot that explains why people move here.

items.title: Desert morning
items.goal: Everyday lifestyle footage that cuts into almost anything.
items.desc: A dog picking a line across the slickrock. Lifestyle filler that cuts into almost anything.

items.title: Sandtown Pizza
items.goal: Get locals through the door on a slow weeknight.
items.desc: Menu board, room tone, and the food shot honestly — 4K, downtown on Bluff Street.

items.title: Mac bar counter
items.goal: Make a counter-service spot feel like somewhere to sit down.
items.desc: Warm counter light and a menu overhead, shot to feel like walking in at lunch.

items.title: Lemon Lab
items.goal: Make a simple drink the reason to stop.
items.desc: Fresh lemonade poured over gingham at 60fps — slowed just enough to hold the pour.

items.title: Paletas, dipped to order
items.goal: Sell the process rather than the finished product.
items.desc: The chocolate dip in one unbroken take. Process shots like this outperform the finished-product photo.

items.title: Mini pies, boxed
items.goal: Keep the branding legible while the food does the work.
items.desc: Labelled lids lined up on the board — a bakery flat-lay with the branding kept legible.

items.title: Treatment, explained
items.goal: Answer the nervous question before it gets asked.
items.desc: A med-spa procedure filmed close with captions carrying the explanation — educational content that answers the question before it is asked.

items.title: In the treatment room
items.goal: Take the mystery out of a first appointment.
items.desc: Seventy seconds start to finish, gloved and unhurried, so a nervous first-timer knows exactly what to expect.

items.title: Mapping the work
items.goal: Show the craft behind a step people never see.
items.desc: Ink lines drawn on skin before the procedure — the prep step most brands never think to film.

items.title: A careful fitting
items.goal: Handle a sensitive service with warmth rather than polish.
items.desc: A specialist fitting appointment handled gently on camera, shot for a subject that needs warmth over polish.

items.title: Prenatal session
items.goal: Deliver clean footage the practitioner can caption themselves.
items.desc: Hands-on work through a birth-ball session — delivered clean, with no captions, for the client to caption themselves.

items.title: Close work
items.goal: Hold attention on close, detailed work.
items.desc: A detail piece cut to music — hands working small, kept in tight the whole way through.

items.title: ToyDash
items.goal: Get a parent to understand the app in one scroll.
items.desc: Screen-recorded pick-and-rank flow cut against real play — an app walkthrough aimed squarely at parents.

items.title: Hawaii Fluid Art
items.goal: Make a studio session look like a family afternoon out.
items.desc: Poured paint spreading in real time. A studio activity that sells itself if you just hold the shot.

items.title: A good day in the showroom
items.goal: Lead with the people rather than the product.
items.desc: Customers, a gift box, a room mid-celebration — the human moment rather than the product.

items.title: Audio guestbook
items.goal: Show an event rental in the room it belongs in.
items.desc: A vintage handset on a whiskey barrel, waiting for messages. Event rental content that shows the piece in situ.

items.title: Stage night
items.goal: Capture a live performance cleanly in difficult light.
items.desc: Low-light stage footage held steady through a full number — the hardest condition to shoot clean.

items.title: Pageant night
items.goal: Cover a one-take event with no second chances.
items.desc: Sash, crown and the hug straight after. Shot fast, outdoors, with no second take available.
